title: Press release
description: A one-page news release on organization letterhead (AP style: dateline, inverted pyramid, quote from a named official, ### end mark, boilerplate). Used both as an inject (another agency's release) and as the model answer for a player's holding statement.

org.description: Issuing organization on the letterhead (defaults to brand.aliases.org)

releaseDate.description: Date (and time) printed under the release line

examples: NCIA Confirms Flight Information Display Outage; Airport Remains Safe and Open
Travelers should confirm gate and departure times with their airline app

dateline.description: AP dateline that opens the first paragraph (city in capitals, state, date)

body.description: Release body. Blank lines separate paragraphs; the dateline is prepended to the first paragraph automatically.
examples: Northeast Central Interstate Airport (NCIA) is investigating a technical issue...

boilerplate.description: 'About the organization' paragraph after the ### mark
examples: Northeast Central Interstate Airport serves more than 10 million passengers a year...
